easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: The Academy, Team 7, and the Land of Waves.
easy.spoiler: Safe through the first arcs of Part 1.

questions.q: What is Naruto's goal from episode one?
questions.note: So that everyone has to acknowledge him.

questions.q: What is sealed inside Naruto?
questions.note: Kurama, sealed by the Fourth Hokage on the day Naruto was born.

questions.q: Which village is Naruto from?
questions.note: Konohagakure.

questions.q: Who are the three members of Team 7 under Kakashi?
questions.note: A dead-last, a genius, and the one who has to hold them together.

questions.q: What is Kakashi's nickname?
questions.note: For copying over a thousand jutsu with his Sharingan.

questions.q: Which clan does Sasuke belong to?
questions.note: And he is nearly the last of them.

questions.q: What is Naruto's signature clone technique?
questions.note: The forbidden technique he learned in one night.

questions.q: What food is Naruto obsessed with?
questions.note: Ichiraku Ramen, specifically.

questions.q: Which eyes does the Hyuga clan have?
questions.note: Near-360 degree vision and the ability to see chakra.

questions.q: What is Rock Lee's specialty?
questions.note: He cannot use ninjutsu at all, so he became the best without it.

questions.q: Who is Naruto's teacher at the Academy?
questions.note: The first adult who treats him like a person.

questions.q: Which village is Gaara from?
questions.note: Sunagakure, and he later leads it.

questions.q: What animal follows Kiba everywhere?
questions.note: The Inuzuka clan fights alongside their partners.

questions.q: Who was the Fourth Hokage?
questions.note: The Yellow Flash. Also Naruto's father, though nobody tells Naruto for years.

questions.q: Which of the Legendary Sannin trains Naruto?
questions.note: The self-declared super-pervert.

questions.q: What is Sakura trained to become in Part 2?
questions.note: Under Tsunade, with monstrous strength as a bonus.

questions.q: What technique is Naruto's spinning ball of chakra?
questions.note: Invented by the Fourth Hokage. It took three years to finish.

questions.q: Which clan technique lets Shikamaru control an enemy's movement?
questions.note: The Nara clan, and Shikamaru is the smartest person in the show.

medium.label: Medium
medium.blurb: All of Part 1 and the first half of Shippuden.
medium.spoiler: Spoilers through Pain's assault on the Leaf.

questions.q: Who are the three Legendary Sannin?
questions.note: Named by Hanzo of the Salamander after they survived him.

questions.q: What is Zabuza's enormous sword called?
questions.note: Kubikiribocho, which repairs itself with iron from the blood it spills.

questions.q: What was Haku's bloodline ability?
questions.note: Combining water and wind, using only one hand.

questions.q: Who killed the Third Hokage?
questions.note: During the invasion of the Chunin Exams, at the cost of his arms.

questions.q: What is the second stage of the Chunin Exams held in?
questions.note: Where Orochimaru brands Sasuke.

questions.q: Which tailed beast is sealed in Gaara?
questions.note: Which is why he never sleeps.

questions.q: Who is Itachi's partner in the Akatsuki?
questions.note: The Monster of the Hidden Mist, carrying a sword that eats chakra.

questions.q: What is Deidara's art made of?
questions.note: Art is an explosion, as he will happily explain at length.

questions.q: Where did Kakashi's Sharingan come from?
questions.note: A gift on the day Kakashi thought Obito died.

questions.q: Who is Naruto's mother?
questions.note: The Nine-Tails' previous host, from the Hidden Whirlpool.

questions.q: What is the real name of the man who calls himself Pain?
questions.note: He uses Yahiko's corpse as the body that does the talking.

questions.q: Which technique does Sasuke learn from Kakashi?
questions.note: A thousand birds. It only works with the Sharingan to see with.

questions.q: Who was the Third Hokage?
questions.note: The God of Shinobi, and Konohamaru's grandfather.

questions.q: What clan was Kimimaro the last survivor of?
questions.note: Bone manipulation, and a body already dying of illness.

questions.q: Where do Naruto and Sasuke fight at the end of Part 1?
questions.note: Under the statues of Hashirama and Madara. It happens twice.

questions.q: What splits the Hyuga clan in two?
a: A main house and a branch house
questions.note: The branch house wears a seal that can kill them at a thought.

questions.q: What does Tsunade's necklace originally belong to?
questions.note: She has given it away twice, both times to someone who died.

questions.q: Which summoning animals does Jiraiya contract with?
questions.note: Mount Myoboku, where Naruto later learns Sage Mode.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: The Fourth Great Ninja War and everything behind it.
hard.spoiler: Spoilers for the entire series, ending included.

questions.q: Who ordered Itachi to destroy the Uchiha clan?
a: The Leaf's leadership, with Danzo pushing hardest
questions.note: Itachi took the mission to prevent a civil war, and let Sasuke hate him for it.

questions.q: What is Shisui Uchiha's legendary genjutsu?
questions.note: It changes a person's will without them ever knowing.

questions.q: Whose cells did Danzo graft into his arm?
questions.note: Along with ten Sharingan, which is exactly as grim as it sounds.

questions.q: What is Obito's space-time technique called?
questions.note: The reason attacks pass straight through him.

questions.q: Who gave Nagato his Rinnegan?
questions.note: Planted in him as a child, for Madara's own plan long after his death.

questions.q: What is the name of the Sage of Six Paths?
questions.note: Who split the Ten-Tails into the nine tailed beasts.

questions.q: Who is the final enemy of the series?
questions.note: The mother of chakra, who takes over the moment Madara thinks he has won.

questions.q: What is Might Guy's eighth and final gate technique?
questions.note: The Gate of Death. It should have killed him.

questions.q: Which technique brings the dead back to fight?
questions.note: Invented by the Second Hokage, abused by everyone after him.

questions.q: What is Sasuke's black, unquenchable flame called?
questions.note: It burns for seven days and nights unless the caster stops it.

questions.q: Who was Kakashi's father?
questions.note: Who chose his comrades over the mission, and was destroyed for it.

questions.q: Which tailed beast does Killer B carry?
questions.note: The only jinchuriki on genuinely good terms with his beast.

questions.q: What was the Hidden Mist Village nicknamed?
questions.note: For graduation exams where students had to kill each other.

questions.q: Who becomes the Sixth Hokage?
questions.note: Danzo held the title briefly, and unofficially.

questions.q: What is the name of Naruto's and Sasuke's final battlefield?
questions.note: Same place as Part 1. They each lose an arm there.

questions.q: Who was Hashirama Senju's wife?
questions.note: The first host of the Nine-Tails.

questions.q: What does Izanami do, unlike Izanagi?
a: It traps the caster's target in a loop until they accept reality
questions.note: Itachi uses it on Kabuto. It costs the caster an eye either way.

questions.q: Which two brothers do Naruto and Sasuke reincarnate the wills of?
questions.note: The Sage's sons, still arguing thousands of years later.
